hero.title: Economic Dynamics
hero.subtitle: To understand the health of an economy, it is not enough to simply consider a single metric like the total money supply or GDP. A national economy is better modeled as a dynamic system of financial flows. This framework can inform internal fiscal policies as well as provide direction for international development plans.

contentBlocks.heading: NECSI has begun a detailed analysis of the dynamic flow of money in economic systems. Our models can begin to guide monetary and fiscal policy towards sustained economic growth.
